subject: science
name: Science
title: Grade 11 Science: Physics
overview: Grade 11 Science provides collegiate-level scientific inquiry across chemical, physical, and environmental systems aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Design empirical laboratory investigations, analyze complex data sets, and account for experimental error.
Model atomic, molecular, physical, and ecological systems using mathematical and conceptual tools.
Apply scientific principles to solve technological and ecological problems through engineering design.
Evaluate the ethical, societal, and environmental consequences of scientific discoveries.

modules.title: Classical Mechanics: Kinematics, Forces & Momentum
modules.description: Quantifying 1D and 2D motion, projectile trajectories, Newton's laws of motion, conservation of momentum, and impulse.

topics.title: Kinematics: Velocity, Acceleration and Projectile Motion
topics.description: Applying kinematic equations to calculate position, velocity, and trajectory of falling and launched projectiles.

topics.title: Newton's Laws, Friction and Free-Body Diagrams
topics.description: Analyzing normal, gravitational, tension, and frictional forces using vector free-body diagrams.

topics.title: Conservation of Linear Momentum and Impulse
topics.description: Calculating impulse (J = F*delta t) and modeling elastic and inelastic collisions.

modules.title: Work, Energy, Gravitation & Orbital Mechanics
modules.description: Analyzing work-energy theorem, kinetic and potential energy, Newton's law of universal gravitation, and Kepler's planetary laws.

topics.title: Conservation of Mechanical Energy
topics.description: Calculating kinetic energy, gravitational potential energy, and elastic spring potential energy (Hooke's Law).

topics.title: Universal Gravitation and Keplerian Planetary Orbits
topics.description: Applying F_g = G(m1*m2)/r^2 to calculate gravitational attraction and satellite orbital velocities.

modules.title: Electromagnetism, Wave Optics & Quantum Phenomena
modules.description: Investigating Coulomb's law, electric circuits, electromagnetic induction, wave interference, diffraction, and the photoelectric effect.

topics.title: Electric Fields, Voltage, Current and Ohm's Law
topics.description: Applying V = IR and calculating equivalent resistance and power in series and parallel circuits.

topics.title: Electromagnetic Induction and Transformers
topics.description: Modeling Faraday's law of induction in electrical generators, electric motors, and power grids.

topics.title: Wave Optics and the Dual Nature of Light
topics.description: Analyzing double-slit interference, diffraction gratings, photon energy (E = hf), and the photoelectric effect.
